headline:
What Happens After A Foreclosure
Notice In Georgia?
titan_answer: In Georgia, the mortgage company has to send the owner written notice at least 30 days before the sale. The sale is the first Tuesday of the month, on the courthouse steps. If you or someone you know is in this spot, reach out early to an attorney or a HUD-certified housing counselor.
source: Georgia Legal Aid (updated Feb 13, 2026) · Georgia Attorney General (read Nov 20, 2026)
disclaimer: General information, not legal advice. Your own situation is a question for an attorney or a HUD-certified housing counselor.
